text: Hovione Holding AG is a family-owned pharmaceutical group; its own press room describes Guy Villax as non-executive director and chairman of the family council, speaking for the company's principal shareholder.
short: Hovione Holding AG is family-owned; the Villax family is the principal shareholder.

source.name: Hovione: 'Hovione nomeia Stefan Doboczky como Chief Executive Officer' (press release, hovione.pt press room)
source.note: The page is the Hovione press room; below the January 2025 rugby-sponsorship release it carries the full text of the 8 September 2026 CEO-appointment release, which calls Hovione 'um grupo familiar' (a family group) and describes the family-council chairman as representing the principal shareholder.
source.quote: Guy Villax, Administrador Não Executivo e Presidente do Conselho de Família, em representação do principal acionista da empresa
